Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing members of legislative bodies to serve as volunteer ambulance personnel.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to volunteer ambulance personnel; and amending RCW35A.11.110.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 35A.11.110 and 1993 c 303 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the legislative body ofany code city, by resolution adopted by a twothirds vote of the fulllegislative body, may authorize any of its members to serve asvolunteer fire fighters, volunteer ambulance personnel, or reserve lawenforcement officers, or ((both)) two or more of such positions, and toreceive the same compensation, insurance, and other benefits as areapplicable to other volunteer fire fighters, volunteer ambulancepersonnel, or reserve law enforcement officers employed by the codecity.
